decision: The title correctly led to an observed ETH previous-high break, but the speaker discourages a fresh immediate long and waits for a future pullback. ENS supplies a retrospective box-break/retest example but no contemporaneous new order. Thus S14 does not satisfy H07's strict positive breakout-entry gate. It does reinforce that outer-structure state, entry timing and position state must be tracked separately; neither a raw H06 line crossing nor an outer high break alone justifies a new native annual variant. Continue source-case search or a predeclared causal diagnostic without choosing parameters from exposed annual PnL.
